page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m4.large is a burstable virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled. The processor operates at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz and is supported by 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance is positioned in the lower tiers of compute and memory throughput. The stress-ng single-core benchmark scores 1057.79, while the multi-core score reaches 2090.03, placing it in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block speed of 150.43 GB/sec and a large block write speed of 14.44 GB/sec. In application-level benchmarks, the instance achieves 2.54 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and 1.48 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation model, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for workloads with low baseline CPU utilization that experience occasional spikes. It is not suitable for sustained high-performance computing, large-scale database hosting, or memory-intensive tasks. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, development and testing environments, low-traffic microservices, and basic background task processing.
